verdict.rationale: Kimi is a consumer AI assistant, so a real-time voice conversation is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions voice input, speech output, or real-time spoken conversation. The help-center topics, the Code docs and the community posts cover text chat, agents, coding, PPT, deep research and similar features only.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant
